name: Voxtype Waveform
description:
Audio waveform OSD and status indicator for the Voxtype push-to-talk dictation daemon.

While you dictate it draws a floating waveform at the bottom of the screen and shows the daemon state (ready / recording / transcribing) in the top bar, with a menu to start, stop or restart the daemon, switches for two Voxtype text options and a shortcut to its configuration file. It targets GNOME on Wayland, where Voxtype's own OSD cannot render because Mutter does not implement the wlr-layer-shell protocol.

Requires the voxtype daemon and its voxtype-audio-bridge sidecar to be installed and running (https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype). The extension does not bundle, download or modify them.
